player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in Nim.
Your goal is to take the last remaining object.
On each turn, choose exactly one pile and remove one or more objects from it.
Use the format '[pile quantity]', where pile is the pile index and quantity is the number of objects to remove.
For example, '[0 3]' removes 3 objects from pile 0.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mana allin riqsisqa t'ikrasqa tarikunchu. "[pile quantity]" nisqawan llamk'apuy.
invalid_move.correct_format_wrong_fields: Kawakim {player_id}, Mana allin llamk'ay. Sutun {col} waqaychaw kanchu.
invalid_move.exceeds_pile: Mana {quantity} q'apakunata q'umir {pile_index}-manta hurq'uyta atinichu ( {pile_count} q'apakunallataq).
